castelgrande.name: Castelgrande
castelgrande.slogan: A fortress on a rock that has guarded the Alpine passes for two thousand years.
castelgrande.line: The first fort on this gneiss outcrop was built in the late 1st century BC under Augustus; the castles became UNESCO-listed in 2000.

locarnomadonnasasso.name: Madonna del Sasso
locarnomadonnasasso.slogan: A pilgrim's stairway above the lake, lit by a vision.
locarnomadonnasasso.line: A friar reputedly saw a Marian apparition here on 15 August 1480, and the wooden Madonna was carved in 1485.

locarnopiazzagrande.name: Piazza Grande
locarnopiazzagrande.slogan: Arcades by day, the biggest outdoor cinema in the Alps by night.
locarnopiazzagrande.line: Since 1971 the Locarno Film Festival has screened here to over 6,000 spectators under the open sky.

luganoangioli.name: Santa Maria degli Angioli
luganoangioli.slogan: A whole wall of Renaissance Passion, painted in Lugano.
luganoangioli.line: Bernardino Luini's monumental Passion and Crucifixion fresco here is dated 1529.

luganogandria.name: Gandria
luganogandria.slogan: Steep stone lanes where the lake once was the only road.
luganogandria.line: Gandria is a car-free village of about 200 year-round residents; its border post is now the Swiss Customs Museum.
